title: Florida Spaceport Improvement Program Project Handbook 2025-2026
summary: FDOT's current project handbook defines the Spaceport Improvement Program's application, eligibility, agreement, reimbursement, project-management, and closeout framework.
key_findings: The handbook provides the current state process for candidate spaceport infrastructure projects.
Program participation still requires project-specific prioritization, agreements, delivery, documentation, and closeout.
Eligibility and process rules do not establish that a named project was funded or completed.
why_it_matters: It turns the state capital rail into a delivery checklist that can be applied to named projects.
ftfn_relevance: Adds current program mechanics to the Space Coast dossier.
Creates a path from candidate project to agreement and closeout.
Preserves program eligibility, award, construction, and acceptance as separate stages.
evidence_limits: The handbook is not a project award or executed agreement.
It does not prove construction, reimbursement, acceptance, operation, or impact.
